about: Simulated answers for promise_extract@v1, written before the first live run. Kept OUT of tests/eval/recordings on purpose: the harness never lets a new prompt pass on simulated answers (tests/evalkit/generate.py SIMULATED_REFS). The offline eval replays these only while no live recording exists; EVAL_LIVE=1 EVAL_RECORD=1 uv run pytest -m eval tests/test_promise_extract_eval.py -k live -s writes tests/eval/recordings/promise_extract@v1.json, and from then on the offline gate replays that.
